name: 13039 · Cicero, NY
findings: ZIP 13039 (Cicero) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13039 (Cicero) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13039 (Cicero) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.
